title: Apple to shutter its first unionized US store in Maryland
title_zh: 苹果将​​关闭位于马里兰州的第一家美国工会商店
summary: April 9 (Reuters) - Apple said on Thursday that it will shut down its retail store in Towson, Maryland, the first of its U.S. locations where retail employees successfully unionized in 2022.
summary_zh: 4 月 9 日（路透社）——苹果周四表示，将关闭位于马里兰州陶森的零售店，这是 2022 年零售员工成功加入工会的美国第一家零售店。

title: Meta pulls ads aimed at recruiting plaintiffs for social media addiction lawsuits
title_zh: Meta 撤下旨在招募社交媒体成瘾诉讼原告的广告
summary: By Diana Novak Jones CHICAGO, April 9 (Reuters) - Meta Platforms said on Thursday it is pulling ads from Facebook and Instagram aimed at recruiting new plaintiffs for ongoing litigation accusing it
summary_zh: 芝加哥，4 月 9 日（路透社） - Meta Platforms 周四表示，它正在从 Facebook 和 Instagram 上撤下广告，旨在招募新的原告，以应对正在进行的指控它的诉讼

title: Apple Will Close Its First Unionized Retail Location in the US
title_zh: 苹果将​​关闭其在美国的第一家工会零售店

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures inch down as Strait of Hormuz remains closed ahead of peace talks
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货小幅下跌，因霍尔木兹海峡在和谈前仍处于关闭状态
summary: Investors remain driven by developments in Iran following the re-closure of the Strait of Hormuz.
summary_zh: 霍尔木兹海峡重新关闭后，伊朗事态发展仍然是投资者的驱动力。

title: Wall Street ends higher as Middle East peace talks lift sentiment
title_zh: 中东和平谈判提振市场情绪，华尔街收高

title: Is Anthropic's Claude Mythos an AI nightmare waiting to happen?
title_zh: Anthropic 的克劳德神话是一场即将发生的人工智能噩梦吗？
summary: Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) is claiming that its new Claude Mythos AI model may be too powerful and is limiting its release after it reportedly “found thousands of high-severity vulnerabilities, including some in every major operating system and web browser," and could be used to hac...
summary_zh: Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) 声称，其新的 Claude Mythos AI 模型可能过于强大，并且在据报道“发现了数千个高严重性漏洞，其中包括每个主要操作系统和网络浏览器中的一些漏洞”后限制了其发布，并且可用于攻击……

title: Amazon CEO's AI chip vision could end up challenging Nvidia
title_zh: 亚马逊首席执行官的人工智能芯片愿景最终可能会挑战英伟达
summary: In his annual letter to shareholders, Amazon (AMZN) CEO Andy Jassy highlighted the tech giant's latest push into AI chip manufacturing and forecasts on its AWS business (Amazon Web Services).
summary_zh: 亚马逊（AMZN）首席执行官安迪·贾西（Andy Jassy）在致股东的年度信中强调了这家科技巨头在人工智能芯片制造方面的最新进展以及对其 AWS 业务（亚马逊网络服务）的预测。

title: Investors turn bearish on the Mag 7 ahead of tech earnings season
title_zh: 在科技财报季到来之前，投资者对 Mag 7 持悲观态度
summary: Investors are turning even more bearish on the Magnificent Seven ahead of this coming earnings season, which comes after these companies lean even heavier into their AI investments with massive increases to capex.
summary_zh: 在即将到来的财报季到来之前，投资者对七巨头的看法变得更加悲观，因为这些公司更加倾向于人工智能投资，资本支出大幅增加。

title: Does Amazon really have more growth avenues than McDonald's?
title_zh: 亚马逊真的比麦当劳有更多的增长途径吗？
summary: Yahoo Finance's "Market Madness" bracket tournament has come down to its Final Four companies, determined by expert analyst commentary in each round: Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL), Walmart (WMT), Amazon (AMZN), and McDonald's (MCD).
summary_zh: 雅虎财经的“市场疯狂”分组赛已决出最后四家公司，每轮由专家分析师评论决定：Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL)、沃尔玛 (WMT)、亚马逊 (AMZN) 和麦当劳 (MCD)。
